security.authorization: CloudClient::AuthorizedNow requires active phase, entitlement, and verification within 120 seconds; heartbeat runs every 45 seconds.
security.uiGate: gate view licenseValid is enforced for guarded operations; signed-out gate was verified on the final installed build.
security.productionCdp: WebView2 remote debugging is disabled unless WEBVIEW2_REMOTE_DEBUGGING_PORT is explicitly set.
security.keyStorage: Windows DPAPI-protected API key save/read was verified.
security.captureProtection: Default is enabled; persisted captureProtection is applied at startup. Screenshot verification used an explicit opt-out preference.
security.installer: Per-user HKCU install and uninstall, no elevation requested.

limitations: The hosted subscription backend was exercised only against a local cloud fixture, not a deployed production service.
Live hosted provider chat was not tested because no real provider API key was available; the OpenAI-compatible mock verified the request/response and streaming path.
Firefox and Brave were not installed, so real OS typing was not tested in those browsers.
The embedded browser uses one shared WebView2 controller with per-tab history; it is not a true multi-WebView implementation.
npm run test:reference is an Electron/Playwright workflow check and does not validate the native host.
The installer and RuntimeHost.exe are unsigned.
GitHub Actions status must be checked after the delivery push; no gh CLI was installed.
verdict: Functional native Windows rebuild with verified OS input, embedded browser, assistant bridge, subscription gate, packaging, and installer lifecycle. Not fully production-final for public distribution until the hosted backend, a real provider E2E run, code signing, and CI/release delivery are verified.
